params.name: longitude
params.description: The angular distance of a place east or west of the meridian at Greenwich, England, or west of the standard meridian of a celestial object, usually expressed in degrees and minutes.

params.name: radius
params.description: The circumference distance in kilometers from the given latitude and longitude.
